item.title: Man, grandmother charged in ‘horrific’ death of 5-year-old Kinsleigh Welty take plea deals
item.description: Ryan Smith has taken a plea deal in the death of 5-year-old Kinsleigh Welty, which will drop three of his four felony charges and have him serve 20 years in federal prison in exchange for his testimony against Toni McClure and Tammy Halsey in their upcoming trials.

item.title: House passes Indiana redistricting bill 57-41; bill now moves to Senate
item.description: The Indiana Statehouse passed a bill to redraw the state's congressional districts, splitting Marion County into four districts, with Democrats criticizing the move as breaking up communities and diluting minority voices.
